posts.title: The Agent Is Not the Scanner: Making AI Security Agents Better
posts.description: Eight months of testing security agents taught me that more scaffolding is not always better. Here’s where skills and MCP helped, where they hurt, and how I route models now.

posts.title: Analyzing a Compromised Linux Machine

posts.title: Vajra Spy - An Android Malware
